info.name: WonderTutor API
info.description:
Run "1. Auth > Login (parent)" and "Login (admin)" first: they save the tokens used by every other request.
Seed accounts: parent@wondertutor.local / Parent1234, admin@wondertutor.local / Admin1234.
Tip: run "npm run dev:respond -- <bookingId> accept" in the backend folder to answer a booking as the tutor.

item.name: Register (OTP is printed in the backend console)
Create booking request (change the date to a free slot)
Start sandbox checkout (put the bookingId in the body)
Photo upload signature (501 until Cloudinary keys are set)
Approve qualification (set the id in the URL)
Forgot password (code is printed in the backend console)
Browse tutors, page 2 of 9 per page
Ask to reschedule (CONFIRMED booking; use a free tutor slot)
Answer the tutor's reschedule: accept | decline | withdraw (set the request id)
Create a TRIAL booking request (only the child's first lesson with this tutor)
Leave a review with an optional photo (Cloudinary URL only)
Add one confirmed lesson to a calendar (.ics file)
Add all upcoming confirmed lessons to a calendar (.ics file)
Privacy: what must be finished before I can delete my account
Privacy: DELETE my account (cannot be undone!)
